    // pairs values are non-nil (`V & {}`), which says nothing about being a table:
    // `{}` in tlua is "any non-nil value", so neither it nor an unconstrained V & {}
    // may pass where a `table` is required.
    local function takesTable(t: table) end
    
    local function unconstrained<V>(t: Table<string, V>)
        for _, v in pairs(t) do
            local x: table = v

    end
